evals.prompt: Scaffold the backend from a PRD that says Backend Needed is Yes and lists POST /submissions, GET /submissions, GET /submissions/{id}, and POST /submissions/{id}/approve. Use FastAPI and type-safe dummy data.
evals.expected_output: A backend scaffold plan or output with FastAPI structure, Pydantic models, health route, route handlers, placeholder persistence, tests, and verification.
expectations: The output checks AGENTS.md, PRD.md, Backend Needed, existing server folder, and backend routes before scaffolding.
The output creates route handlers matching the PRD routes without inventing unrelated routes.
The output avoids NotImplementedError stubs and returns type-safe dummy data.

evals.prompt: Can you run scaffold-backend even though my PRD says Backend Needed? No. I think maybe we still need one.
evals.expected_output: A fail-fast response that refuses to scaffold while the PRD says no backend and tells the user to update the PRD first.
expectations: The output refuses to create backend files when Backend Needed is No.
The output explains that the PRD must be updated before backend scaffolding.
The output does not create routes or dependencies anyway.
